data.title: Finding the Area of Trapezoids
data.description: Practice calculating the area of various trapezoids by applying the average-of-bases formula.

challenges.narration: The cross-section of a bucket is shaped like this trapezoid.
challenges.instruction: Find the area of this trapezoid.
challenges.hint: Average the two bases, then multiply by the height: ½ × (b₁ + b₂) × height.
